source_requirement: 冷却水泵的密封、轴承和电机维护要有空间，不能拆一个小件就要移开很多管路。

candidate.shall_statement: 冷却水泵的密封、轴承和电机应布置为可直接拆卸和更换，无需先移开无关管路。
candidate.measurable_criterion: [Q]冷却水泵必须易于拆卸（Engine water pumps must be easy to remove），且管路布置应允许接近开口并便于拆卸端盖和抽出管束（Piping shall be arranged to provide access to openings and to permit convenient removal of heads and pulling of tubes）。
candidate.applicable_condition: 适用于冷却水泵（含密封、轴承、电机）的维护拆装作业；具体机型、泵型及安装位置未知，需由项目安装规范确认。
acceptance_criteria: 冷却水泵可在不移除无关管路的情况下拆卸
泵密封、轴承和电机维护点具备可达通道
管路布置不阻碍泵的拆卸路径

evidence_citations.source: S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide

[E001] 层级:L3 来源:S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide
  内容: 冷却设备可维护性与隔离阀要求
Long-term preservation treatments for cooling systems can be provided by the factory, refer to the Price List for more information. Serviceability and Isolation Valves Access to the heat exchangers is required for cleaning or removal of the tube-bundle assemblies or plates. Engine water pumps must be easy to remove. Remote water temperature regulators should be accessible and have appropriate isolation valves to allow servicing of engine and temperature regulators without draining
